template.name: Landledger: raise or hold an AI budget
template.description: When a Landflow agent has spent 80% of its monthly AI cap, the agent asks Landledger (with its sponsor, who confirms it) for more, with the month’s spend and forecast as evidence. If the approvers say yes, and the request is this flow's own with a verified origin, the flow raises the agent’s cap by the approved amount through Landflow’s API, publishes it and marks the request applied: at most once per agent and month, finishing a raise that stopped half way every hour; otherwise the cap holds.

credentials.name: Landledger (requests)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with read and requests:write (bound to this workflow in Landledger, so its origins are verified). Never decisions:relay or admin.

credentials.name: Landledger (webhooks)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with webhooks:write only: the Landledger Trigger subscribes itself on publish and keeps the signing secret Landledger returns (never shown). Or the whsec_ secret of a webhook an admin made, in Webhook Signing Secret.

credentials.name: Landflow API key
credentials.description: A Landflow API key (lf_…) that can read usage and read, save and publish agents.

setup: Pick or add **Landledger (requests)**: the API URL and an `ll_` key with `read` and `requests:write`, bound to this workflow in Landledger (`boundWorkflowIds`): **Plan the raise** acts only on requests whose origin Landledger verified.
Pick or add **Landledger (webhooks)** for **Request decided**: a key with only `webhooks:write` (or the `whsec_` secret of a webhook an admin made).
Add a **Landflow API key** (Settings → API keys) that can read usage and read, save and publish agents.

In **Settings** and **Raise settings**, set `LANDFLOW_URL` to this Landflow (as Landflow reaches itself), the cost center that pays for agents, the sponsor (the person accountable for the agents, not an approver; they confirm each request in Landledger), the threshold and how much to ask for; **Raise settings** caps any raise (`MAX_CAP`) and how often a failed publish is retried (`MAX_ATTEMPTS`).
Agents need a **monthly cost limit** (agent → Settings) for the flow to watch them.

The new cap is the cap in force plus the approved amount, once per agent and month. An agent with unpublished edits is held: **Plan the raise** says why, and a person raises its cap by hand. **Every hour** finishes raises that stopped half way.
Publish: Landledger must reach `LANDFLOW_PUBLIC_URL` for request.decided.

workflow.name: Landledger: raise or hold an AI budget
workflow.description: At 80% of an agent’s monthly AI cap, an ai_budget request with the forecast; on approval of this flow's own, verified request the cap is raised by the approved amount through Landflow’s API, once per agent and month, reconciled hourly.

nodes.name: Agent AI calls
nodes.notes: Every agent AI call, five minutes at a time: one run reads each agent that spent.

nodes.name: Over the threshold
nodes.notes: Keeps the agents past the threshold of their monthly cap (the published caps, the ones enforced) with the forecast and the extra amount to ask for.

nodes.name: Ask to raise the cap

parameters.title: Raise {{ $json.agentName }}'s monthly AI cap by ${{ $json.extra }}
parameters.note: {{ $json.agentName }} has spent ${{ $json.spent }} of its ${{ $json.cap }} monthly cap ({{ $json.share }}%); the month is forecast at ${{ $json.forecast }}. Approve to raise the cap by ${{ $json.extra }}; reject to hold it (the agent stops at the cap).

requestFields.originTitle: Raise or hold an AI budget

nodes.notes: One request per agent and month (the idempotency key). The sponsor confirms it in Landledger before the approvers see it.

nodes.name: Hold the cap
nodes.notes: Rejected, cancelled or expired: the cap stays and the agent stops at it.

nodes.name: Every hour
nodes.notes: Reconcile: approved requests whose raise did not finish (a failed publish, a Mark Applied that did not land) are finished here.

nodes.name: Raises this month
nodes.notes: What this flow raised this month, and how far each got.

nodes.name: What to do
nodes.notes: raise: save and publish the new cap · publish: a saved raise to publish again · markApplied: the cap is already raised · hold: a person decides · skip: nothing to do

nodes.name: Publish the agent
nodes.notes: Only the cap changed (Plan the raise held any agent with other unpublished edits), so the evaluation gate is skipped.

parameters.appliedNote: {{ $('Plan the raise').item.json.agentName }}'s monthly AI cap raised from ${{ $('Plan the raise').item.json.oldCap }} to ${{ $('Plan the raise').item.json.newCap }} in Landflow.
parameters.links: {{ [{ label: $('Plan the raise').item.json.agentName + ' in Landflow', url: $('Plan the raise').item.json.landflowUrl + '/agents/' + $('Plan the raise').item.json.agentId }] }}

nodes.name: Put the cap back
nodes.notes: A failed publish leaves no saved cap behind, so later raises are not held as unpublished changes.

column.value: {{ String($('Publish the agent').item.json.error?.message ?? $('Publish the agent').item.json.error ?? 'publish failed').slice(0, 500) }}

nodes.name: Report: publish failed
nodes.notes: The request stays approved. Every hour the reconcile run tries again (up to Raise settings' MAX_ATTEMPTS), then holds it for a person; the table says what failed.

nodes.name: Hold: raise by hand
nodes.notes: Plan the raise says why (not this flow's key, an origin not verified, not this agent, already raised this month, out of range, unpublished edits, or publishing kept failing). A person raises it, then marks the request applied in Landledger.
